name: Benzyl octanoate
description: Benzyl octanoate (CAS 10276-85-4 ), also known as benzyl caprylate, is an ester used as a flavoring agent and emollient carrier in food and personal care applications. It combines a mild, fatty-floral character with good solubility in oils. This makes it a functional ingredient for formulators working across both sectors. In flavor systems, it contributes a soft, fatty-floral note used in fruit, dairy, and confectionery flavor compositions. Personal care formulators use it as a skin-conditioning carrier and solvent for fragrance concentrates, active ingredients, and lipophilic extracts in serums, creams, and oils. Its low polarity supports solubilization of fragrance materials. In anhydrous and low-water formulations, it reduces the need for synthetic solvents. In fine fragrance and cosmetic blending, it functions as a fixative carrier that improves the spreadability and skin feel of finished products. The compound is supplied as a clear, colorless to pale yellow liquid. It is available in cosmetic-grade and food-grade specifications to meet the requirements of personal care and flavor manufacturers respectively. Standard packaging ranges from small drums to bulk quantities suited to industrial procurement volumes.
